steps.zh-TW: 用手機點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製邀請碼 WTR7WBTZ，再開啟下載連結；電腦開啟只會看到請改用手機的提示。
steps.en: On a phone, select “Sign up”: this site copies invite code WTR7WBTZ first, then opens the download link. A computer only shows a notice to use a mobile device.

steps.zh-TW: 連結會依手機系統轉到 App Store 或 Google Play 的台北捷運Go 頁面；請只從商店頁安裝。
steps.en: The link goes to the 台北捷運Go page on the App Store or Google Play, depending on the phone; install only from the store page.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 依畫面指示註冊，在要求邀請碼的地方貼上 WTR7WBTZ，或依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入；欄位位置本站未確認。
steps.en: Register in the app as directed; paste WTR7WBTZ where an invite code is requested, or type it as shown (case-sensitive). Field location unconfirmed.

intro.zh-TW: 臺北大眾捷運股份有限公司的會員 App：分享文案附有邀請碼 WTR7WBTZ，下載連結須用手機開啟。
intro.en: Member app of Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation: the share text carries invite code WTR7WBTZ, and its download link opens only on a phone.

description.zh-TW:
台北捷運Go 是臺北大眾捷運股份有限公司的行動 App，可免費下載，提供路線查詢、首末班車與到站資訊；會員另有捷運點與優惠券。

本站的連結不含邀請碼，須用手機開啟：點擊「立即註冊」會先複製邀請碼 WTR7WBTZ，再開啟分享文案中的下載連結。分享文案沒有說明回饋，本頁不列優惠；實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
台北捷運Go is the free mobile app of Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation, the operator of the Taipei Metro. It offers route lookup, first and last train times and arrival information, and members can also use Metro points and coupons.

The link on this page does not carry the invite code and must be opened on a phone: selecting “Sign up” first copies code WTR7WBTZ, then opens the download link from the share text. The share text states no reward, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案只有邀請碼與下載連結，邀請碼不在連結中，也不是個人連結。ws.metro.taipei 是北捷網域 metro.taipei 的子網域；北捷官網首頁介紹台北捷運Go，商店連結與轉址目標是同一個 App。維運者 2026-10-25 開啟並讀過該頁原始碼：手機依系統轉到商店，電腦只顯示請用行動裝置的提示。轉址由網頁程式決定，可能變更。本站未註冊，邀請碼是否被接受未經測試。App Store 分級 4+，官網未找到會員條款。
notes.en: The share text gave only the invite code and a download link; the code is not in the link, and the link is not a personal link. ws.metro.taipei is a subdomain of the operator’s domain metro.taipei, and the operator’s home page presents 台北捷運Go with store links to the same app as the redirect targets. The maintainer opened the page and read its source on 2026-10-25: phones are redirected to the store matching their system, while a computer only shows a notice to use a mobile device. The redirect is set by the page’s script and may change. This site has not registered, so acceptance of the code was not tested. The App Store age rating is 4+, and no membership terms were found on the website.

q.zh-TW: 台北捷運Go 的邀請碼 WTR7WBTZ 要怎麼輸入？
q.en: How do I enter the 台北捷運Go invite code WTR7WBTZ?

a.zh-TW: 邀請碼是 WTR7WBTZ，區分大小寫。本頁連結不含邀請碼，點擊「立即註冊」會先複製它；下載並開啟 App 後，依畫面指示貼上或手動輸入。本站未註冊，邀請碼是否被接受未經測試。
a.en: The invite code is WTR7WBTZ and is case-sensitive. The link on this page does not carry it: selecting “Sign up” copies it first. After installing and opening the app, paste or type it as the screens direct. This site has not registered, so acceptance was not tested.

q.zh-TW: 輸入台北捷運Go 邀請碼有什麼回饋？
q.en: What reward does the 台北捷運Go invite code give?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有說明回饋，本站也沒有在北捷官網找到這組邀請碼的說明，所以不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告與 App 顯示為準。
a.en: The share text states no reward and this site found no explanation of this code on the operator’s website, so no offer is listed. Actual terms follow the official announcements and the app.
